what_it_is: Lamellar 3D titanium posterior lumbar interbody cage. Lamellar 3D Titanium Technology incorporates 300-500 um longitudinal channels with transverse windows creating an interconnected lattice for bony integration. Approximately 70% porosity. Reverse hourglass design allows large graft volume. Bulleted nose for ease of insertion. 3-5 um surface roughness for direct bony ongrowth.
sizing_specs: Full range of implant sizes to accommodate vertebral anatomy.
use_notes: Roughened titanium surfaces shown to demonstrate increased protein expression vs smooth titanium. Now sold by VB Spine.
